build_BaseTransformer: build a BaseTransformer model with configurable MTA attention layers and rotary embeddings
create_MTATransformerArgs: create an MTATransformerArgs dataclass to configure MTA convolution kernel sizes and initialization method
run_Attention_forward: run the Attention module forward pass with optional MTA pre and post softmax convolution
test_RMSNorm: test the RMSNorm normalization layer with configurable elementwise affine scaling and layer rescaling
refactor_TransformerBlock: refactor the TransformerBlock to toggle MTA attention on or off per layer
